## TerritoryBlock

| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 2 |

## TerritoryZone

TerritoryZone defines one circular spawn area and its static and dynamic entity
count limits.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 8 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### TerritoryZone.dmax

Key: `dmax`

Path: [`territory`](#territoryfileterritory).`[]`.[`zone`](#territoryblockzone).`[]`.`dmax`

DMax is the upper bound for the dynamic entity count in this zone. For an
ambient event, its global max can still cap the count across all zones.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `0` |

### TerritoryZone.dmin

Key: `dmin`

Path: [`territory`](#territoryfileterritory).`[]`.[`zone`](#territoryblockzone).`[]`.`dmin`

DMin is the lower bound for the dynamic entity count in this zone. For ambient
spawners, the count is chosen from DMin through DMax, inclusive, when the zone
activates.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `0` |

### TerritoryZone.name

Key: `name`

Path: [`territory`](#territoryfileterritory).`[]`.[`zone`](#territoryblockzone).`[]`.`name`

Name identifies the zone for references and diagnostics.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `Graze` |

### TerritoryZone.r

Key: `r`

Path: [`territory`](#territoryfileterritory).`[]`.[`zone`](#territoryblockzone).`[]`.`r`

| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |

Key: `smax`

Path: [`territory`](#territoryfileterritory).`[]`.[`zone`](#territoryblockzone).`[]`.`smax`
